description_sq: Prane Toptani Center, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Totalisht E Investuar !! title_en: Near Toptani Center, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested!!
description_en: Near Toptani Center, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested!!
